name: Master gunner
description: At the guns facing the enemy, the hands reload faster and aim truer.

name: Helmsman
description: At the helm, the ship dodges more and comes about faster, with less risk of stalling in irons.

name: Carpenter
description: Hands in the same room repair, plug leaks and fight fires twice as fast. Patches hull after a win.

name: Bosun
description: In the rigging, the ship dodges a little more. Mends sails after a win.

name: Surgeon
description: Heals wounded specialists in the sickbay.

name: Boarding master
description: Leads boarding parties across the rail and stiffens the defence when you're boarded. Better grapple throws and rope cutting.
